categories.main_business_segments: Nextool Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: semiconductor packaging equipment and molds, and plastic extrusion molding molds, extrusion molding devices, and downstream equipment. The company focuses on the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent manufacturing equipment tailored for semiconductor packaging and plastic extrusion molding industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including resin handling for semiconductor chip packaging, dynamic PID pressure control, multi-cavity high-speed extrusion molding, co-extrusion molding, and advanced mold design software. It employs advanced manufacturing methods such as automated semiconductor plastic packaging, cutting and forming equipment, and precision extrusion molding with vacuum shaping and cooling systems, integrating intelligent control and real-time monitoring.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic semiconductor packaging companies such as Tongfu Microelectronics, Huatian Technology, and Changdian Technology. The plastic extrusion molding products serve global customers in over 40 countries, particularly in high-end markets in Europe and North America, focusing on plastic profiles for construction, agriculture, transportation, and other industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a significant domestic market presence in semiconductor packaging equipment. Its plastic extrusion molding products have a broad international footprint, exporting to more than 40 countries and regions, with a focus on Europe and North America for high-end markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nextool operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing specialized intelligent manufacturing equipment and molds used by downstream semiconductor packaging and plastic extrusion profile manufacturers. It procures raw materials and components from upstream suppliers and delivers customized equipment to downstream customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D with a focus on advancing semiconductor packaging equipment towards wafer-level and panel-level advanced packaging to achieve import substitution and global competitiveness. It also emphasizes innovation in plastic extrusion molding equipment for intelligent, energy-efficient, and high-output solutions. R&D efforts include collaboration with industry leaders and academic institutions, with significant investment in patent development and technology upgrades.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized intelligent manufacturing equipment and molds to semiconductor packaging and plastic extrusion molding enterprises. The company employs a direct sales model, engaging customers through industry exhibitions, technical visits, and contract-based deliveries with installation and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In semiconductor packaging equipment, the company competes with international giants like TOWA, YAMADA, ASM Pacific, BESI, and DISCO, holding a competitive position among domestic suppliers with growing market share. In plastic extrusion molding equipment, it ranks as a leading domestic player with strong international market presence, competing with European brands such as EXELLIQ.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 268.2 million, a 35.48% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 64 million, up 22.10%. Total assets reached RMB 1.22 billion, growing 6.72%, with steady growth driven by semiconductor market recovery and sustained demand in extrusion molding equipment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nextool emphasizes its unique value through proprietary core technologies, high automation and intelligent control in semiconductor packaging equipment, and advanced extrusion molding technologies. The company offers customized, high-quality, and efficient manufacturing solutions with strong after-sales support, aiming to reduce reliance on imports and compete globally with leading international brands.
